name: Prove Him Wrong
justification: Constructive output (any valid array accepted) — needs a special judge the token checker can't express.
solution_sketch: Need a_i + a_j <= 2|a_i - a_j| for all pairs, i.e. sorted consecutive elements satisfy 3*a_i <= a_j. Powers of 3 work while 3^(n-1) <= 1e9, so YES iff n <= 19.
